checks.title: <html lang> declares the page language
checks.test: Parse server HTML; pass if html[lang] is a valid BCP 47 tag

checks.title: Page has a descriptive <title>
checks.test: Parse server HTML; fail if missing/empty, warn if generic (Home, Untitled) or > 70 chars

checks.title: Landmarks: one <main>, plus header/nav/footer
checks.test: Parse server HTML; count main/role=main (exactly 1), nav, header, footer

checks.title: Heading outline: one <h1>, no skipped levels
checks.test: Parse server HTML; list h1-h6 in order, fail if no h1, warn if >1 h1 or level jumps

checks.title: Every form control has an accessible name
checks.test: Static: input/select/textarea (not hidden/submit) need <label for>, wrapping label, aria-label(ledby) or title

checks.title: Buttons and links have accessible names
checks.test: Static: button, a[href], [role=button] need text, aria-label, aria-labelledby, img alt or title

checks.title: No click-only <div>/<span> controls
checks.test: Static: div/span with onclick or [data-action]-like handlers and no role/tabindex; browser run adds cursor:pointer elements without role

checks.title: Images have alt text
checks.test: Static: img without alt attribute (alt="" allowed for decoration)

checks.title: Key forms are real <form>s with a submit button and action
checks.test: Static: forms have method/action or submit button; inputs outside forms counted; warn on JS-only forms

checks.title: Server HTML carries the content (not an empty JS shell)
checks.test: Static: visible text length of server HTML; fail under 200 chars with a large script bundle; browser run compares with rendered text

checks.title: Rendered page and server HTML say the same thing
checks.test: Browser: share of rendered visible text present in server HTML (token overlap); warn < 70%, fail < 30%

checks.title: The 33 agent-relevant axe rules pass
checks.test: Browser: axe-core runOnly the 33 TARGET_RULES from Lighthouse 13.6.0; fail on any violation (Lighthouse is binary)

checks.title: Interactive elements appear in the accessibility tree with names and roles
checks.test: Browser: accessibility snapshot; share of interactive nodes with a name; list unnamed

checks.title: Custom controls are keyboard-focusable
checks.test: Browser: elements with click listeners / role=button that are not focusable (tabIndex < 0)

checks.title: robots.txt is published
checks.test: GET /robots.txt: 200, text/plain, at least one User-agent line (isitagentready rule)

checks.title: robots.txt parses cleanly
checks.test: Parse per RFC 9309: unknown lines, rules before any User-agent, size > 500 KiB (parser limit), HTML served as robots

checks.title: robots.txt has rules for AI crawlers
checks.test: Named AI tokens or a wildcard group (isitagentready rule); lists which tokens are named

checks.title: AI crawler policy per bot (training / search / user)
checks.test: Evaluate the homepage path for 17 documented AI tokens with RFC 9309 group matching; warn when search or user fetchers are blocked while training is allowed, or all AI is blocked by accident

checks.title: Content-Signal preferences are declared
checks.test: robots.txt Content-Signal line with ai-train, search or ai-input (isitagentready rule)

checks.title: Content-Signal values are well-formed
checks.test: Keys in {search, ai-input, ai-train}, values yes/no, inside a User-agent group

checks.title: AI preferences (Content-Usage, IETF aipref) if present are valid
checks.test: robots.txt Content-Usage lines and Content-Usage response header parsed against the vocab draft; informational when absent

checks.title: Homepage is not noindex/none for everyone
checks.test: Homepage X-Robots-Tag header and <meta name=robots>: fail on noindex/none for all agents

checks.title: Agents get the page, not a challenge
checks.test: GET homepage with this checker's identifying UA vs a browser UA: warn/fail when the bot gets 403/429/challenge HTML and the browser gets 200

checks.title: A sitemap is published
checks.test: /sitemap.xml returns XML, or a Sitemap line in robots.txt (isitagentready rule)

checks.title: Sitemap is valid XML with <loc> URLs on this site
checks.test: Parse urlset/sitemapindex; count URLs; all on the same site; under 50,000 URLs / 50 MB

checks.title: Sitemap carries honest lastmod dates
checks.test: Share of URLs with W3C-datetime lastmod; warn if all identical or in the future

checks.title: robots.txt names the sitemap
checks.test: Sitemap: line(s) present and absolute

checks.title: TDM reservation (TDMRep) if used is valid
checks.test: /.well-known/tdmrep.json and tdm-reservation header/meta; informational

checks.title: RSL licence pointer if used resolves
checks.test: robots.txt License: line / <link rel=license type=application/rsl+xml>; fetch and check XML; informational

checks.title: Page has JSON-LD structured data
checks.test: Static: script[type="application/ld+json"] blocks on the homepage (and the sampled page)

checks.title: JSON-LD blocks parse as JSON
checks.test: JSON.parse each block; report position of errors

checks.title: JSON-LD uses the schema.org context
checks.test: @context is https://schema.org (or http) in each top-level node or @graph

checks.title: @type values exist in schema.org
checks.test: Every @type checked against the bundled schema.org type list (release noted in the report)

checks.title: Properties exist in schema.org
checks.test: Every property name checked against the bundled schema.org property list

checks.title: Key properties are filled for the main types
checks.test: Organization/WebSite/Product/Offer/LodgingBusiness/Event/Article/FAQPage: required-for-meaning fields (name, url, offers.price+priceCurrency, startDate...)

checks.title: Structured data matches visible content
checks.test: name, headline, price and description values found in visible server text (normalised); warn below 80%, fail below 50%

checks.title: Homepage identifies the organisation (Organization/WebSite)
checks.test: Organization or WebSite node with name and url; sameAs and logo noted

checks.title: Canonical URL is declared and consistent
checks.test: link rel=canonical present, absolute, same site; matches final URL or redirects there

checks.title: Meta description and Open Graph basics
checks.test: meta description, og:title, og:description present

checks.title: Markdown via Accept: text/markdown
checks.test: GET homepage with Accept: text/markdown; pass on Content-Type text/markdown (isitagentready rule)

checks.title: Negotiated responses send Vary: Accept
checks.test: Both the HTML and Markdown responses carry Vary including Accept, so caches do not mix them

checks.title: The Markdown is real Markdown with the page content
checks.test: Markdown body is not HTML, has a heading, shares >= 50% of key terms with the HTML text

checks.title: Pages link their Markdown twin
checks.test: <link rel=alternate type=text/markdown> or Link header; fetch it, expect text/markdown or text/plain

checks.title: llms.txt is published
checks.test: GET /llms.txt: 200 text, not HTML

checks.title: llms.txt follows the format (H1, summary, link lists)
checks.test: Lighthouse llms-txt rules: H1, Markdown link, >= 50 chars; plus blockquote summary and H2 sections

checks.title: llms.txt links resolve
checks.test: HEAD/GET up to 15 linked URLs (robots-respecting); warn on any 4xx/5xx, fail if most fail

checks.title: llms-full.txt (optional)
checks.test: GET /llms-full.txt; informational, size reported

checks.title: Link headers point agents to resources
checks.test: Homepage Link header with agent-useful rels (service-desc, describedby, api-catalog, alternate markdown, sitemap, ...) (isitagentready rule)

checks.title: Feeds are discoverable (RSS/Atom/JSON Feed)
checks.test: link rel=alternate with feed types; fetch first and validate root element

checks.title: Responses support conditional requests
checks.test: Homepage has ETag or Last-Modified; a conditional request returns 304

checks.title: API catalog at /.well-known/api-catalog
checks.test: GET /.well-known/api-catalog: linkset+json with linkset array (isitagentready rule)

checks.title: API catalog entries are complete
checks.test: Content-Type application/linkset+json; each entry has anchor and service-desc/service-doc; links resolve

checks.title: OpenAPI description is discoverable
checks.test: Find via api-catalog service-desc, Link header, or /openapi.json, /openapi.yaml, /.well-known/openapi.json

checks.title: OpenAPI document is valid
checks.test: Parse JSON/YAML; openapi 3.x, info.title/version, paths; refs resolve locally

checks.title: Operations are described for agents
checks.test: Share of operations with operationId, summary/description, described parameters and response schemas

checks.title: Errors use problem+json (RFC 9457)
checks.test: Request an unknown path under the API base; expect application/problem+json with type/title/status

checks.title: Rate limits are announced in headers
checks.test: API responses carry RateLimit/RateLimit-Policy (draft-11) or Retry-After on 429

checks.title: Deprecation/Sunset headers are well-formed (if used)
checks.test: Deprecation (RFC 9745 structured date) and Sunset (HTTP-date) on API responses; informational

checks.title: Key actions have a machine interface
checks.test: If the site has forms or commerce signals: at least one of API catalog/OpenAPI, MCP endpoint or WebMCP tools

checks.title: MCP server card is published
checks.test: /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json, /.well-known/mcp/server-cards.json or /.well-known/mcp.json with a name (isitagentready rule)

checks.title: Server card is complete and points to a live endpoint
checks.test: serverInfo name+version, transport/remotes url, capabilities; SEP-2127 location also checked

checks.title: MCP endpoint answers initialize
checks.test: POST initialize (protocolVersion 2026-07-28) to the endpoint from the card/ARD or /mcp; pass on a JSON-RPC result or a spec 401 challenge

checks.title: Server speaks a current MCP protocol version
checks.test: protocolVersion from initialize; warn on versions before 2025-06-18

checks.title: tools/list returns tools (public endpoints)
checks.test: tools/list on public endpoints; count and names; skipped when auth is required

checks.title: Tool inputSchemas are valid JSON Schema objects with descriptions
checks.test: Each tool: name pattern, description length, inputSchema type object, properties described, required subset

checks.title: Endpoint rejects foreign Origin headers
checks.test: POST initialize with Origin: https://evil.example; spec says servers MUST validate Origin (DNS rebinding); pass on 403/400

checks.title: Page exposes WebMCP tools
checks.test: Browser with WebMCPTesting: document.modelContext.getTools(); static fallback finds registerTool calls and <form toolname> (isitagentready rule)

checks.title: Forms declare toolname and tooldescription
checks.test: Every <form> has both attributes (Lighthouse webmcp-form-coverage)

checks.title: Declarative tool attributes and field names are valid
checks.test: toolname pattern, descriptions, named fields with toolparamdescription; Lighthouse 0/0.5/1 scoring

checks.title: Imperative tools have valid input schemas
checks.test: Each registered tool: inputSchema is a JSON Schema object, required subset of properties, outputSchema valid if given

checks.title: Tool count stays manageable (<= 40)
checks.test: Count of registered tools; warn above 40 (Lighthouse threshold)

checks.title: Tool descriptions tell an agent when to use them
checks.test: Description length 20-500 chars, starts with a verb, names inputs; duplicates flagged

checks.title: Tools carry readOnlyHint / untrustedContentHint annotations
checks.test: Read-only-looking tools (get/search/list/check) marked readOnlyHint; write tools not

checks.title: WebMCP origin-trial token (for Chrome) if WebMCP is used
checks.test: meta http-equiv=origin-trial or Origin-Trial header; informational

checks.title: ARD manifest is discoverable
checks.test: Agentmap robots line, link rel=ard, Link header, /.well-known/ard.json, legacy /.well-known/ai-catalog.json (isitagentready + Lighthouse order)

checks.title: ARD manifest is valid
checks.test: specVersion, host, entries with urn:air identifier, displayName, IANA media type, exactly one of url/data; warns on legacy location

checks.title: Agent Skills index is published
checks.test: /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json (or legacy /.well-known/skills/index.json) with a skills array (isitagentready rule)

checks.title: Skill entries are complete and digests match
checks.test: $schema, name/type/description/url/digest per entry; fetch each skill (max 10) and compare sha256 digest

checks.title: A2A Agent Card (opt-in)
checks.test: /.well-known/agent-card.json with name, version, supportedInterfaces (isitagentready rule, opt-in)

checks.title: DNS-AID records under _agents
checks.test: DNS-over-HTTPS SVCB/HTTPS lookup of _index._agents.<host> and _mcp/_a2a, DNSSEC AD flag (isitagentready rule)

checks.title: Personal Agent Protocol manifest (informational)
checks.test: /.well-known/poppy.json organisation/domain/interfaces (isitagentready rule, informational)

checks.title: Unknown paths return 404 (no soft-404s)
checks.test: GET a random /.well-known path and a random page; a 200 HTML answer makes every probe ambiguous and agents waste requests

checks.title: Well-known JSON files are served as JSON
checks.test: Every found well-known JSON resource has a JSON media type and parses

checks.title: Commerce signals detected
checks.test: Product/Offer JSON-LD, cart/checkout links, platform markers (Shopify, WooCommerce...); decides whether commerce checks score

checks.title: Products/offers have price, currency and availability
checks.test: Product/Offer JSON-LD: offers.price, priceCurrency, availability; checked against visible price

checks.title: UCP business profile
checks.test: /.well-known/ucp with protocol_version (or ucp.version) and services (isitagentready rule)

checks.title: UCP profile lists capabilities and reachable endpoints
checks.test: capabilities array, services with transport endpoints, endpoints on https

checks.title: ACP discovery document
checks.test: /.well-known/acp.json with protocol.name/version, api_base_url, transports, capabilities.services (isitagentready rule)

checks.title: x402 payment-required responses
checks.test: Paid API routes (from OpenAPI/catalog) answer 402 with x402 payment requirements (isitagentready rule)

checks.title: MPP payment info in OpenAPI
checks.test: /openapi.json operations with x-payment-info (isitagentready rule)

checks.title: AP2 extension in the A2A card
checks.test: A2A Agent Card extensions include AP2 with a role (isitagentready rule)

checks.title: Vacation Rental Protocol offers (informational)
checks.test: /.well-known/vacation-rental.json; informational for lodging sites

checks.title: OAuth/OIDC authorization server metadata
checks.test: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server or openid-configuration with issuer, endpoints, grant types (isitagentready rule)

checks.title: OAuth Protected Resource Metadata
checks.test: /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource (and path-suffixed for the MCP endpoint) with resource and authorization_servers (isitagentready rule)

checks.title: Authorization server supports PKCE S256
checks.test: code_challenge_methods_supported includes S256 (required by MCP authorization)

checks.title: Agent clients can register (CIMD preferred over DCR)
checks.test: client_id_metadata_document_supported true (MCP 2026-07-28); registration_endpoint only = warn (DCR deprecated for MCP)

checks.title: auth.md agent registration
checks.test: /auth.md exists, PRM discoverable, AS metadata has agent_auth (isitagentready rule)

checks.title: Web Bot Auth key directory (for sites that send bots)
checks.test: /.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory: JWKS with Ed25519 keys, correct media type; informational like isitagentready

checks.title: No hidden prompt-injection text
checks.test: Static + browser: text hidden by CSS/aria-hidden/off-screen/zero-size/same-colour that matches instruction patterns (ignore previous, you are an AI, system prompt...)

checks.title: Machine-readable files carry no instructions to agents
checks.test: Scan llms.txt, Markdown twin, JSON-LD and meta for instruction-like patterns aimed at models

checks.title: Destructive tools are marked as such
checks.test: MCP + WebMCP tools with write verbs (delete, book, pay, send) have destructiveHint/readOnlyHint false; read tools readOnlyHint

checks.title: HTTPS with HSTS
checks.test: http:// redirects to https://; Strict-Transport-Security max-age >= 1 year

checks.title: Baseline security headers
checks.test: Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options

checks.title: security.txt contact
checks.test: /.well-known/security.txt with Contact and Expires in the future

checks.title: Privacy policy and terms are linked machine-readably
checks.test: link rel=privacy-policy / terms-of-service, or anchors named privacy/terms on the homepage

checks.title: Consent banner does not block content for agents
checks.test: Browser: fixed/sticky overlays with consent words covering >30% of the viewport, and whether content is readable without clicking

checks.title: Global Privacy Control support declared
checks.test: /.well-known/gpc.json with gpc: true; informational

checks.title: Risky tools ask a human to confirm
checks.test: WebMCP/MCP write tools: annotations or descriptions show a confirmation step (requestUserInteraction / elicitation); informational heuristic

checks.title: Layout is stable (CLS)
checks.test: Browser: PerformanceObserver layout-shift (buffered) over load + 3 s; good <= 0.1, poor > 0.25 (web.dev thresholds)

checks.title: Server responds quickly (TTFB)
checks.test: Homepage time to first byte from the checker; good <= 0.8 s, poor > 1.8 s (web.dev)

checks.title: Text responses are compressed
checks.test: Homepage with Accept-Encoding: gzip, br; Content-Encoding present

checks.title: Few redirects to the homepage
checks.test: Redirect chain length from the entered URL; warn above 2

checks.title: HTML is a reasonable size
checks.test: Server HTML bytes and DOM node count reported; informational, warns only past Googlebot's documented 15 MB HTML fetch limit
